row.statement: The sponsor should break the blind only for the participant affected by the SUSAR and, whenever possible, keep the blind for those analysing and interpreting results and those responsible for continuing the trial (managers, monitors, investigators), who should continue receiving SUSARs in blinded form.
row.quote: Recomenda-se que o patrocinador quebre o cegamento da atribuição do tratamento apenas do participante em questão afetado pela SUSAR e, sempre que possível, preserve o cegamento para os responsáveis pela análise e interpretação dos resultados do estudo e pelos responsáveis pela continuidade do ensaio clínico, como gerentes, monitores e investigadores do estudo. row.quote_en: It is recommended that the sponsor break the blind of the treatment allocation only of the participant concerned affected by the SUSAR and, whenever possible, preserve the blind for those responsible for the analysis and interpretation of the study results and for those responsible for the continuation of the clinical trial, such as study managers, monitors and investigators. In this way, these professionals must continue to receive the SUSARs in blinded form.
